meta.name: infinitetalk
meta.description: 音频驱动的稀疏帧视频配音工具，支持音频驱动的 Video-to-Video 和 Image-to-Video 生成，实现精准的唇形、头部、身体姿态同步，支持无限时长视频生成

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用音频驱动生成同步唇形和姿态的视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为视频或图片人物精准匹配音频口型和动作
copy.tagline_en: Generate lip-synced videos driven by audio
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to match audio with precise lip and body movements in videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用你提供的音频驱动生成说话人视频：从单张图片合成会说话的视频，或给现有视频重新配音，并让唇形、头部、身体姿态与音频同步，也支持生成超长视频。
howto.when: 当你需要音频驱动的数字人视频、视频配音或虚拟主播内容时触发，比如要求“把这张照片变成说话视频”或“给这段视频配音”。

say.text: 用这张图片和这段音频生成一个说话视频
say.note: 会运行脚本生成同步视频

say.text: 给这个视频重新配上一段新的中文旁白
用这句话生成语音并做成说话视频

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses your audio to drive talking-head video generation: it can create a talking video from a single image, or re-dub an existing video, syncing lips, head, and body pose with the audio. It also supports generating videos of unlimited length.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need audio-driven digital human videos, video dubbing, or virtual anchor content, e.g., asking to turn a photo into a talking video or to re-dub a video.

say_en.text: Generate a talking video from this image and this audio.
say_en.note: Runs the script to create a synced video.

say_en.text: Re-dub this video with a new Chinese narration.
Turn this sentence into speech and make a talking video.
say_en.note: Uses TTS first, then generates the video.
